subject: Re: OpenMSD status: sources landed, join-key quality risk
body:
Rosa, Bruno,

Closing out the window. The normalization layer was the right call - final join retains 99.1% of citation edges versus 96.2% naive, and the language-skew problem is gone from Gustavo's QA sample. Relation extraction finished May 16; citation, co-citation, and bibliographic-couple pair sets are all built and counts are in the datasheet.

Decisions:

1. Handoff to Corpus slips two business days to June 1, the last day of our window, to include the fuzzy-recovery documentation in the datasheet. Jun, Bruno will send the transfer manifest today so your side can prep.

2. Scope cut: the full-text enrichment pass (beyond metadata + abstracts) is out for v1. It roughly doubles storage and the retrieval teams confirmed metadata-level records unblock them.

3. The July rerun schedule Bruno set up stands; Rosa owns the rerun runbook so it isn't head-knowledge.

Good work - this one was quietly hard.

Dmitri
